Professional Summary
Azure-focused DevOps engineer with experience delivering cloud automation, CI/CD pipelines, and containerized deployments. Skilled at designing infrastructure-as-code, optimizing build and release processes, and enabling development teams to ship reliably using Agile practices.

Technical Skills
Microsoft Azure, Terraform, Azure DevOps, Docker, PowerShell, Linux, Git, Agile

Work Experience

Azure DevOps Engineer, Razorpay (Jan 2025 - Present)
- Implemented automated deployment pipelines on Microsoft Azure using PowerShell scripts to provision resources and perform post-deployment configuration, reducing manual steps by 80%.
- Containerized microservices with Docker and integrated with Azure Container Registry, enabling blue-green deployments through Azure DevOps pipelines.
- Configured monitoring and alerting for production workloads using Azure services and Git-backed pipeline templates to ensure consistent rollouts across environments.

Azure DevOps Engineer, Tata Consultancy Services (Sep 2022 - Dec 2024)
- Built end-to-end CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps integrating Terraform for infrastructure provisioning on Microsoft Azure, accelerating environment provisioning from days to under an hour.
- Developed modular Terraform modules and managed state securely, enabling repeatable deployments across multiple projects.
- Automated container build and release processes using Docker and Azure DevOps, and wrote PowerShell tasks for deployment orchestration and health checks.

Azure DevOps Engineer, Quanta Retail (Nov 2021 - Aug 2022)
- Designed and maintained Terraform-based IaC to provision Microsoft Azure resources for retail applications, improving infrastructure consistency across dev, test, and prod.
- Created Docker images and managed container registries; integrated image build and scan steps into Azure DevOps pipelines to improve release safety.
- Authored PowerShell automation for environment setup and routine maintenance on Linux hosts, streamlining developer onboarding tasks.

Education
B.Sc Computer Science, St. Xavier's College
